name: docker_scan
description: Trigger Docker security scan job on Jenkins for the specified Docker image. Use when users ask to scan Docker images for security vulnerabilities. Requires image_name parameter (e.g., 'alpine:3.19', 'opensearch:2.11.0'). Examples: 'scan alpine:3.19', 'run security scan on nginx:latest'

image_name.description: Full Docker image name including tag (e.g., alpine:3.19, opensearchproject/opensearch:2.11.0)

name: trigger_job
description: Trigger any supported Jenkins job with specified parameters. Use for generic job triggering when users specify a job name and parameters. Supports all registered Jenkins jobs with parameter validation.

job_name.description: Name of the Jenkins job to trigger (e.g., docker-scan, build)

job_parameters.description: JSON object containing job-specific parameters. Each job has different required and optional parameters.

name: test_connection
description: Test connection to Jenkins server and validate credentials. Use for troubleshooting or verification. Returns Jenkins version and server information. No parameters required.

name: get_job_info
description: Retrieve detailed information about a Jenkins job including parameters and requirements. Use when users need to understand job requirements or available parameters. Defaults to docker-scan job if no job specified.

job_name.description: Name of the Jenkins job to get information about (defaults to docker-scan)

name: list_jobs
description: List all Jenkins jobs supported by this agent with their parameters and descriptions. Use when users ask 'what jobs are available?' or need to see all supported Jenkins operations.
